query: How do I reset my password?
expectedAnswerSummary: Go to the login page, click Forgot Password, enter your email, check inbox (and spam). Link expires in 24 hours.

query: How do I invite my teammates to my workspace?
expectedAnswerSummary: Go to Settings > Members > Invite, enter emails, choose roles, send invites. Teammates receive email to accept.

query: I keep getting a 401 Unauthorized error on my API key.
expectedAnswerSummary: Check key is copied correctly with no extra spaces; verify it has the right scope; regenerate if needed from Settings > API Keys.

query: My authenticator code is not being accepted for 2FA login.
expectedAnswerSummary: Time sync issue on device. Set phone clock to automatic. On iOS: Settings > General > Date & Time > Set Automatically. Use backup code if needed.

query: How do I export my project data as CSV?
expectedAnswerSummary: Settings > Data > Export, select CSV. Option is greyed out on free plan; upgrade to Pro or Enterprise for bulk export.

query: Can I set up SSO with Okta?
expectedAnswerSummary: Yes. Go to Settings > Security > SSO, follow the SAML 2.0 setup guide, paste Okta metadata URL.

query: My Slack integration is not sending notifications.
expectedAnswerSummary: Reconnect the Slack integration in Settings > Integrations; ensure the bot is invited to the target channel; re-authorize if token expired.

query: How does the refund policy work?
expectedAnswerSummary: 30-day refund window from purchase date. Full refund for annual plans if requested within 30 days.

query: How do I revoke access for a team member who left?
expectedAnswerSummary: Go to Settings > Members, find the member, click Remove. Their sessions are invalidated immediately.

query: How long are my uploaded file attachments stored?
expectedAnswerSummary: Attachments are stored for the lifetime of the account. On account deletion, files are purged within 30 days per the data retention policy.

query: How do I set up a custom domain?
expectedAnswerSummary: Settings > Custom Domains > Add Domain. Add the CNAME record to your DNS provider. Propagation takes up to 48 hours.

query: My webhook endpoint is receiving duplicate events.
expectedAnswerSummary: Use the event ID in the payload for idempotency. Webhooks may retry on timeout; ensure your endpoint responds with 2xx within 5 seconds.

query: How do I import tasks from a CSV file?
expectedAnswerSummary: Settings > Import > CSV. Download the template, fill it in, upload. Up to 5,000 rows per import.

query: I am getting 429 rate limit errors on the API.
expectedAnswerSummary: You have exceeded the per-minute request limit. Implement exponential backoff with jitter. Check your plan's rate limit in the API docs.

query: How do I enable dark mode?
expectedAnswerSummary: Click your avatar in the top-right > Appearance > Dark Mode toggle.

query: Does Acme SaaS support multiple workspaces under one account?
expectedAnswerSummary: Yes. Each workspace is isolated. You can switch between them from the workspace selector in the sidebar.

query: How do recurring tasks work?
expectedAnswerSummary: Open a task > Recurrence > set frequency (daily/weekly/monthly/custom). A new instance is created automatically when the current one is completed.

query: How do task due date reminders work?
expectedAnswerSummary: Reminders are sent via email and in-app notification 24 hours before the due date. You can adjust timing in notification settings.

query: How do I see who made changes — is there an audit log?
expectedAnswerSummary: Settings > Audit Log. Shows all user actions with timestamp, actor, and change details. Admins only.

query: I want to cancel my subscription and get a refund.
expectedAnswerSummary: Cancel in Settings > Billing > Cancel Plan. If within 30-day window, contact support for a refund. Annual plans refunded pro-rated if cancelled within 30 days.

query: The dashboard is loading very slowly on Firefox.
expectedAnswerSummary: Clear Firefox cache and disable extensions. If the issue persists, check for hardware acceleration in Firefox settings or try a different browser to isolate the cause.

query: Our Google Calendar OAuth connection expired. How do I reconnect?
expectedAnswerSummary: Settings > Integrations > Google Calendar > Reconnect. Re-authorize with your Google account. Existing events will re-sync automatically.

query: How do I verify webhook signatures?
expectedAnswerSummary: Use HMAC-SHA256 with your webhook secret. Compute the signature over the raw request body and compare to the X-Acme-Signature header.

query: Does Acme SaaS support tasks with multiple assignees?
expectedAnswerSummary: Yes, on Pro and Enterprise plans. Open a task > Assignees > add multiple team members.

query: How do I set up Jira two-way sync?
expectedAnswerSummary: Settings > Integrations > Jira > Connect. Authenticate with Jira, choose the projects to sync, and map task statuses to Jira statuses.

query: I accidentally deleted a project. Can I recover it?
expectedAnswerSummary: Deleted projects are in Trash for 30 days. Go to Settings > Trash, find the project, and click Restore.

query: What happens to our data if we downgrade our plan?
expectedAnswerSummary: Data is retained but features above your new plan limit become read-only. You have 30 days to export or delete data that exceeds the new plan's limits.

query: How does mid-cycle user seat pricing work?
expectedAnswerSummary: New seats are pro-rated for the remainder of the billing cycle. The charge appears on your next invoice.

query: I lost my 2FA backup codes. How do I recover my account?
expectedAnswerSummary: Contact support with account verification (ID or billing proof). Support can disable 2FA so you can log in and re-enroll a new authenticator.

query: How do I set up the GitHub integration to link PRs to tasks?
expectedAnswerSummary: Settings > Integrations > GitHub > Connect. Authorize the GitHub app, select repos. Mention the task ID (e.g. ACM-123) in a commit or PR title to auto-link.
